messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Has the warehouses received both of my return packages, email (email hidden)

Jeff, two of your four returns have reached our Chattanooga warehouse, and two haven't been logged yet.

Arrived November 5:
the NerdQaxe++ for Shop····, with $198.99 store credit added that day, and the Bitaxe Gamma for Shop····, with $72.00 store credit added that day.

Not received yet:
the NerdQaxe++ for Shop···· (USPS (number hidden)) and the Bitaxe Gamma for Shop···· (UPS (number hidden)).

Did those two go out in the same drop-off as the others?

Thanks, Jeff. Since those two went out on their own, they're most likely still in transit. Our warehouse hasn't logged either one yet.

As Georges said, each one gets store credit when it arrives: $273.99 for Shop···· and $92.00 for Shop····.

When did you drop those two off? If it's been more than a few days, I'll ask the warehouse to look into them.

You're welcome, Jeff. Once those last two returns arrive, the credit goes on your account.

Before you go, I have one question. What are you thinking of putting the store credit toward?
I didn't catch that, Jeff. Did "B" mean the Harlo B30 or the Hammer BC04? Either way, the credit will be waiting on your account whenever you want to use it.
Do you remember offering me a store credit of 25 dollars like 2 week ago

Yes, Jeff, I found it. On October 28 we gave you $25 off a future order. It's a discount code, not store credit on your account.

Your code is HD-••••••. It works once, on an order of $100 or more. Just enter it at checkout.

That $25 is separate from the store credit for your returns, so you can use both on your next order.
Thank you I took a screenshot of the code

Good idea, Jeff. You'll also get a copy of this whole chat at (email hidden) once we're done here, so the code will be in there too.

I'll keep an eye out for your last two returns. Enjoy the rest of your day.
